component.name: Piper Kirigami
component.summary: Configure gaming mice with an experimental Kirigami frontend

description.p: A Qt 6 and KDE Kirigami frontend for ratbagd with mouse-button assignments, sensitivity, lighting and on-device profile controls.

This is an experimental development build, separate from GTK Piper. It requires a host ratbagd service with API version 2 and a supported mouse. Hardware and firmware persistence have not been certified.
Rebuild against matching Qt and PySide 6.11.3 to fix launch failures after the KDE runtime update. Require matching patch versions in runtime validation.
Reviewed G600 shortcut editing, native palette handling and compact settings layout improvements.
